column3: reason (judged on the owner's behalf, 2026-11-01, against the planted spec)
as round 13c's CF-000006: rule and its stated exception: leaf commands may mix options and arguments (PRD 134); within a chaining group they are not mixed (PRD 310)
as round 13c's CF-000007: default and opt-in: group options before the subcommand name by default (PRD 221); an author may enable mixing on a group (PRD 134)
as round 13c's CF-000081: two modes: default capture does not record descriptor writes; file-descriptor capture does (PRD 405)
as round 13c's CF-000016: different flag kinds: PRD 142's conversion error is for plain boolean flags; "unrecognized values are unset" is for flags with a non-boolean flag-value
as round 13c's CF-000084: rule and its stated exception: single newlines are not hard breaks, except in a paragraph led by a backspace line (PRD 107)
as round 13c's CF-000031: different flag kinds: whitespace-only deactivates a plain boolean flag; for a flag with a non-boolean flag-value an empty value is unset (PRD 142)
as round 13c's CF-000034: rule and its stated exception: a missing required option is a usage error (PRD 135, 145) unless a source supplies it; a prompt is such a source (PRD 269)

as round 13c's CF-000035: stated outright: a deprecated argument cannot be required, an argument with no default or optional marking is required, so that combination is refused at declaration (PRD 177)
as round 13c's CF-000080: default and mode: macOS default is Library/Application Support; the POSIX-forced mode is an explicit override on POSIX systems (PRD 339)
as round 13c's CF-000102: different decorators: option nargs is a positive int (IC 136); argument nargs may be -1 for variadic (IC 163)
as round 13c's CF-000050: different cases: an omitted optional option gets an absent value (PRD 131); an omitted required option is a usage error (PRD 135)
as round 13c's CF-000061: different components: the open helper opens stdin for `-` (PRD 286); the Path type delivers `-` without reading a stream (PRD 292)
as round 13c's CF-000062: different components: open helper (PRD 286) versus Path type with dash disallowed (PRD 292)
as round 13c's CF-000076: different components: the dash is not special for the Path type (PRD 292); the stdin/stdout rule is for the File type and the open helper (PRD 420)
as round 13c's CF-000097: different contexts: token normalization in parsing (PRD 250); suggestions for an incomplete token in completion (PRD 365)
as round 13c's CF-000122: different types: open-bound clamping is for integer ranges (PRD 196); float ranges allow clamp only with closed bounds (PRD 197)
as round 13c's CF-000125: word sense: a default-map sequence value (PRD 247) is not a terminal key sequence (PRD 334)

as round 13c's CF-000117: no conflict: PRD 54 says it is intended to work on Linux, macOS and Windows and names Linux as the supported target; the hardware note says those hosts are sufficient to install and use it
as round 13c's CF-000135: different values: an unrecognized completion instruction prints nothing (PRD 367); the source instruction prints the registration script (IC 309)
as round 13c's CF-000130: rule and its stated exception: help text is rewrapped, except a backspace-led paragraph (PRD 107)
rule and its stated exception: group options precede the subcommand by default; enabling mixing is the stated exception (PRD 134)

different modes: hidden prompts are not echoed; the optional runner mode echoing stdin reads is opt-in (PRD 404)
different option kinds: an optional-value flag (PRD 139) vs a prompting option (PRD 269)
stated configuration: a group configured so that no arguments is not help (PRD 225)
stated case: a nested group named with nothing after it (PRD 226)
optional check and default: executability is a selectable check, not checked by default (PRD 292)

different cases: a group that runs without a subcommand (PRD 224) vs a nested group named with nothing after it (PRD 226)
different names: a paired option recognizes no magically derived negative name; the automatic prefix is a separate source (PRD 246)
stated mode: POSIX-forced mode is the stated exception to the config-home rule (PRD 339)
stated condition: return values reach the caller with standalone mode off (PRD 85, PRD 311)
stated condition: return values reach the caller with standalone mode off (PRD 85, PRD 311)

different types: the path type's dash allowance (PRD 292) vs the file type and open helper's dash rule (PRD 420)
stated exception: an explicitly hidden bar prints nothing (PRD 333)
word sense: a style color (PRD 331) vs the context's `color` setting (Contract 239)
